Overview

Social Hype is a digital marketing agency working with clients in Canada and the UAE through SEO, paid ads, websites and social media. I led all of its web development: the agency's own Canadian and UAE websites, and the client sites it delivered, with end-to-end ownership from scoping to handover.

The challenge

An agency's web work is a portfolio, not a single project: different clients, two markets, two platforms (WordPress and Webflow), and a marketing team that depends on accurate tracking. The job was to make delivery repeatable — consistent builds, reliable performance and clean handovers — while staying the technical point of contact for clients and marketers.

Approach

  1. Agency sites from Figma

    Built socialhype.ca and socialhype.ae from Figma designs in WordPress with Elementor.

  2. A delivery process

    Ran client projects end to end — scoping, build, launch and a structured handover for ongoing maintenance.

  3. Right platform per client

    Built and maintained WordPress (Elementor, WooCommerce) sites, and Webflow sites from Figma with CMS collections, Interactions and animations, SEO settings and client handover.

  4. Measure everything

    Owned performance, technical SEO and tracking across the portfolio: Core Web Vitals, schema, GA4, GTM and Meta Pixel.

  5. Run the infrastructure

    Managed hosting, DNS, SSL and deployments for the portfolio.

What I delivered

  • socialhype.ca and socialhype.ae — Figma to WordPress (Elementor)
  • Client websites in WordPress, Elementor and WooCommerce
  • Client websites in Webflow — CMS, Interactions, animations, SEO
  • Performance and technical SEO across the portfolio
